body: Forward test of the promise-tracker credibility method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.66 (naive base rate 0.60) that: Bharat Electronics FY27 order inflow is ≥₹25,000 cr. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (3-Nov-2026): order book ₹68,717 cr (1-Oct-2026); FY27 inflow so far ~₹7,334–8,000 cr. CMD Manoj Jain: guidance 'order inflow of INR25,000 crores minimum, excluding QRSAM and including QRSAM, INR50,000-plus crores'; NGC (next-gen corvettes) cleared, ~₹20,000 cr from two shipyards expected 'staggered… 99% will come in this financial year'; Shatrughat, Samaghat, HAMMER 'confident to get' before March; QRSAM slipped ~7–8 months ('we may get before March'). In May-2026 (Q4 FY26 call) FY27 inflow guide was '>₹55,000 cr' incl. QRSAM 'very soon'. FY26 actual inflow ₹30,045 cr ('met all guidance parameters'). H1 revenue ₹12,824 cr (+26%) vs 15%+ guide. Reasoning: The ex-QRSAM floor rests mostly on NGC, which is cleared and in contract with shipyards; BEL has met base-order guidance in recent years. The QRSAM history shows timelines slip, so we stay modestly above base. Resolution: YES if BEL's FY27 total order inflow (orders received 1-Apr-2026 to 31-Mar-2027), as stated in its Q4 FY27 results/call or an April-2027 order-book disclosure, is ≥₹25,000 cr (QRSAM included if received). Source: BEL Q4 FY27 results / earnings call transcript / order-book disclosures (NSE). Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs base rate.
